title: The Use of a Community-based Organization to Change Lifestyle Characteristics Related to Non Communicable Diseases
brief_summary: This study attempts to implement a lifestyle intervention programme aimed at changing the dietary habits, physical activity and alcohol and tobacco consumption in the 25-60year old adults in the MOH area, Ragama and measure the effectiveness of the programme.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adults between 25-60 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* adults with psychiatric disorders
